    5.  多线程：系统拥有多个任务(线程)，每个任务(线程)独立并同时运行(可以理解成每个任务都是一个主函数，这些任务都是同时在执行的。具体实现方式以后再学，原理就是PendSV中断等)

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image112.webp)

    2.  使用方式：ESP32使用arduino库+FreeRTOS+MicroROS并通过串口与STM32进行通信。

    3.  主要作用之一：可通过WIFI远程与上位机（电脑、工控机）的ROS2进行更加安全、稳定的通信，对比直接用串口通信（rosserial），要好很多(DDS分布式)。

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image111.webp)

    4.  Simple understanding of FreeRTOS: an operating system with multithreading library features and POSIX standard compatibility

Multithreading: The system has multiple tasks (threads), each task (thread) runs independently and simultaneously (it can be understood as each task being a main function, and these tasks all execute at the same time\. The specific implementation will be learned later; the principle is PendSV interrupts, etc\.)

    3.  One of the main functions: It can communicate more safely and stably with the ROS2 of the host computer (PC, industrial computer) remotely via WIFI\. Compared with direct serial communication (rosserial), it is much better (DDS distributed)\.
